data.name: sqlInsertCommand1.CommandText
data.value: INSERT INTO [dbo].[Пользователи] ([loginUser], [passUser], [accessLevelUser]) VALUES (@loginUser, @passUser, @accessLevelUser); SELECT idPers, loginUser, passUser, accessLevelUser FROM Пользователи WHERE (idPers = SCOPE_IDENTITY())

data.name: sqlUpdateCommand1.CommandText
data.value: UPDATE [dbo].[Пользователи] SET [loginUser] = @loginUser, [passUser] = @passUser, [accessLevelUser] = @accessLevelUser WHERE (([idPers] = @Original_idPers) AND ((@IsNull_loginUser = 1 AND [loginUser] IS NULL) OR ([loginUser] = @Original_loginUser)) AND ((@IsNull_passUser = 1 AND [passUser] IS NULL) OR ([passUser] = @Original_passUser)) AND ((@IsNull_accessLevelUser = 1 AND [accessLevelUser] IS NULL) OR ([accessLevelUser] = @Original_accessLevelUser))); SELECT idPers, loginUser, passUser, accessLevelUser FROM Пользователи WHERE (idPers = @idPers)
